description: Create state and territory funding model registry coverage for NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, and NT with provenance and blocked-source handling.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository now has a runtime JurisdictionFundingModelRegistry with explicit rows for NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, and NT, plus fail-closed blocked and missing handling. It does not claim official extracted funding-model rows for every year or redistribute restricted state and territory schedules.

implemented: explicit source-status rows for NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, and NT
parallel jurisdiction valuation helper for priced rows
fail-closed blocked and missing jurisdiction handling
not_implemented: official extracted funding model rows for every state and territory year
redistribution of restricted state and territory funding schedules
full validated adjustment logic for every jurisdiction-specific caveat

gap_register.description: The registry now exposes explicit rows for every state and territory, but the public fixture set remains intentionally limited to the source and valuation cases visible in the repository.
gap_register.rationale: The track is complete-with-gaps because the registry exists and is explicit, but the repository still does not claim exhaustive official funding coverage.

remaining_external_gates: official state and territory funding-model extraction for additional years
licence review for restricted funding schedules
validation of every jurisdiction-specific adjustment caveat
